article.title: Mimir: a social media platform

image.alt: Detailed screenshot of the Mimir platform
image.caption: Mimir is a social media platform built around CRUD operations.

article.description: Mimir is a social media platform created to practise working with APIs, CRUD operations, authentication, and responsive interfaces. The project focuses on creating a clear experience while handling changing user-generated content.
article.improvement: Improve the responsive layout and accessibility of the main platform views.
article.improvementReason: The project can present its content more clearly on smaller screens and provide stronger interaction feedback for keyboard and assistive technology users.
article.process: The project involved planning the interface, connecting the frontend to the API, building reusable UI patterns, and testing the main user flows.

article.description: Barter is a semester project for an online auction house. The experience is designed to make browsing listings, understanding item information, and taking action feel clear and accessible.
article.improvement: Improve accessibility and clarity across the auction browsing experience.
article.improvementReason: Clearer hierarchy, stronger contrast, and more deliberate interaction states help users understand listings and navigate the service with confidence.
article.process: The project combined interface planning, responsive implementation, content hierarchy, and iterative refinement of the core auction flows.
